_about: SOST decentralization status — canonical machine-readable source. Internal engineering measurements, not an independent third-party audit.

_labels.OBSERVED: directly measured now from this node / chain state
_labels.KNOWN: a documented fact about project-operated infrastructure
_labels.INFERRED: reasoned from observed data; not a direct measurement

consensus_architecture.label: KNOWN
consensus_architecture.note: ConvergenceX / SbPoW Phase-2 + cASERT; operational decentralization is ongoing

active_288.label: OBSERVED
active_288.note: distinct block producers in the last 288 blocks (from geteligibleminers)

producers_since_genesis.label: OBSERVED
producers_since_genesis.note: unique addresses that have ever produced a block

producers_in_window_from_7100.label: OBSERVED
producers_in_window_from_7100.note: unique producers since Phase-2 window start (block 7100)

largest_observed_miner_share.label: INFERRED
largest_observed_miner_share.note: not exposed by a single RPC method; active_288=2 implies recent production is concentrated among very few addresses

observed_connected_peers.label: OBSERVED
observed_connected_peers.note: peers THIS node is connected to; a peer/IP is not evidence of an independent operator

known_independent_nodes.label: UNKNOWN
known_independent_nodes.note: independent ownership is not verifiable from peer IPs; not asserted

known_countries_independent_operators.label: UNKNOWN
known_countries_independent_operators.note: geolocation of a peer IP does not establish an independent operator

infrastructure_nodes_project_operated.note: project-operated infrastructure; historical deployments up to 11 nodes do not equal 11 independent operators

bootstrap_dependencies.label: KNOWN
bootstrap_dependencies.note: all default seeds are under one domain (sostcore.com) — a single DNS/domain dependency; see docs/decentralization/BOOTSTRAP_AUDIT.md

public_rpc_instances.label: KNOWN
public_rpc_instances.note: sostcore.com/rpc/public (project-operated; read + broadcast, admin/wallet methods auth-gated)

release_distribution_sources.label: KNOWN
release_distribution_sources.note: single primary source today (GitHub); reproducible build recipe published (docs/decentralization/REPRODUCIBLE_BUILD.md + Dockerfile.reproducible) for independent hash verification

persistent_peer_recovery.label: KNOWN
persistent_peer_recovery.note: Bootstrap audit (docs/decentralization/BOOTSTRAP_AUDIT.md) finds no persistent peer store and no ADDR/GETADDR gossip in src/sost-node.cpp; automatic redial covers only --connect peers, not seed-only nodes. Earlier 'implemented/lab-verified' wording is not supported by the current code and is being corrected.

disclaimer: These are internal engineering measurements, not an independent third-party audit. A peer/IP is never reported as an independent operator without evidence.
